content.meaning: An abnormally large fall in systolic blood pressure (more than 10 mmHg) during inspiration.
content.seen_in: Cardiac tamponade, severe asthma, COPD exacerbation.
content.how_to_check: With a BP cuff, note when sounds first appear in expiration only, then when they are heard in every beat. A gap of more than 10 mmHg is abnormal.

content.question: What is the rhythm?
content.explanation: Irregularly irregular rhythm with no clear P waves. Flutter is usually regular with a sawtooth baseline.

content.presentation: 58-year-old smoker with 3 weeks of cough, weight loss and a sodium of 124.

differentials.name: Small cell lung cancer
differentials.note: SIADH (low sodium) is a classic paraneoplastic presentation.

content.reason: A smoker with weight loss and low sodium points to a lung tumour making ADH (SIADH).
